faq_heading: Homes near Blacklock Fine Arts Elementary: your questions answered

faq.q: Are the homes on this page in the Blacklock Fine Arts Elementary catchment?
faq.a: Not necessarily. The search finds homes whose listing names the school, and the sold prices are measured by distance. Langley School District sets the catchment and shows it on a map only on its website, so confirm the exact address with the district before you offer.

faq.q: How does the Blacklock Fine Arts Elementary home search find homes?
faq.a: It lists active homes whose listing text names Blacklock Fine Arts Elementary, so a nearby home that leaves the name out will not show.

faq.q: How much do homes near Blacklock Fine Arts Elementary sell for?
faq.a: Within 1 km of the school, 123 homes sold between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026. Medians were houses $1,195,000, townhomes $612,500, condos $459,000. A median is the middle price and is shown where at least 5 homes sold.

faq.q: How fast do homes sell near Blacklock Fine Arts Elementary?
faq.a: Within 1 km of Blacklock Fine Arts Elementary the median was 31 days on the market, closing at 96.4% of the list price, with 5% of sales above the list price for the 123 homes within 1 km.

faq.q: Which schools are closest to Blacklock Fine Arts Elementary?
faq.a: In a straight line, the closest schools in the provincial list are Douglas Park Community (0.6 km north), H D Stafford Middle (0.8 km south-west) and Whytecliff Agile Learning Centre-Langley (1.1 km north).

The search below lists homes for sale whose listing names Blacklock Fine Arts Elementary. Under it are the prices homes sold for within 1 km of the school.
How the Blacklock Fine Arts Elementary search works

MLS® listings are not tagged by school. This search finds houses, townhomes and condos whose description names Blacklock Fine Arts Elementary, so a home close to the school whose listing leaves the name out will not appear, and a listing that names the school can sit farther than 1 km away. Use the sold prices below for the distance-based picture, and ask Jared to watch for homes near the school that the search misses.
What homes within 1 km of Blacklock Fine Arts Elementary sold for

Between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026, 123 homes sold within 1 km of Blacklock Fine Arts Elementary: 31 houses, 17 townhomes and 75 condos. The largest group was condos, at a median of $459,000.

blocks.text: Schools within 3 km of Blacklock Fine Arts Elementary

18 schools in the provincial school list sit within 3 km of Blacklock Fine Arts Elementary in a straight line (8 elementary, 6 secondary, 3 other, 1 middle; 3 independent). The closest is Douglas Park Community, 0.6 km away, and the farthest on this list is Brookswood Secondary, 2.9 km away. By type, the nearest secondary school is Whytecliff Agile Learning Centre-Langley (1.1 km); the nearest independent school is Whytecliff Agile Learning Centre-Langley (1.1 km); the nearest school listing a French Immersion program is Belmont Elementary (2.5 km). Other elementary schools close by: Douglas Park Community (0.6 km north), Nicomekl Elementary (1.2 km west), Simonds Elementary (1.3 km south-west), Uplands Elementary (1.4 km south), Murrayville Academy (1.8 km east). The nearest school teaching the same grades (K-5) is Douglas Park Community, 0.6 km north of Blacklock Fine Arts Elementary.

blocks.text: Before you offer on a home near Blacklock Fine Arts Elementary

items.t: Confirm the catchment for the exact address on the Langley school finder. A home a few blocks from Blacklock Fine Arts Elementary can sit in a different catchment.
Visit on a school day at drop-off and pick-up. Traffic and parking near Blacklock Fine Arts Elementary are very different at 8:30 am and 3 pm than on a Sunday viewing.

Compare price with similar homes farther from the school. The median condo within 1 km of Blacklock Fine Arts Elementary was $459,000, so check whether size and age explain a gap before you pay for the location.
Look at Douglas Park Community, the nearest other elementary school, 0.6 km north of Blacklock Fine Arts Elementary. Compare the two when you check which school serves the address.
